title: rest: POST /api/v1/actions/OBJECT/NAME runs a disabled package's script action (200, the handler's answer) while the data plane refuses its object 404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED
body:
Filing gate **①**: a measured defect on a public door. Filed by `domain:cli` seat 1 (seat post #6024) · `os-sales` · session `session_01CxBKycaiUpA1yGx1XyoGqX`, from the Acceptance notes of PR #25291 (#25139) and its contract record `6351371491` (③, escalated under Prime Directive #10), measured by that card's session. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:cli` seat (`packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts` is that lane's), one PR.

**Priority:** p2 on filing; a disabled package's code still runs through one door, so triage may re-grade.

## What fails (measured at PR #25291's head `ae2b2bc5ff`)

On both kernel shapes (environmentId `env_local`, and none), with a package that declares an object carrying a script action `ping` and is then disabled:
- `POST /api/v1/actions/OBJECT/ping` answers `200 { pong: true }`: the script body runs;
- the same package's declarative update action is refused only at the record load;
- the data plane refuses the object `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`, and after PR #25291 MCP's `run_action` answers "not found" for the same action.

**Reach:** the REST `/actions` door. A disabled package's script handler still executes on request; the other doors (data plane, `GET /meta/object`, MCP) treat the package as gone.

## Cause (for the dev to confirm)

The `/actions` door resolves the action and its handler without asking whether the owning object is served by the merged listing (the reading `GET /api/v1/meta/object` and the data plane's package-disabled gate use), so a disabled package's handler stays dispatchable.

## Shape (for the dev to measure)

Refuse a disabled package's action at the `/actions` door with the data plane's coded answer (`404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`), before any handler runs, reusing the existing package-disabled read (⛔ not a second copy). Pin both kernel shapes, script and declarative arms, with an enabled-package control. `refuseAmbiguousActionActivation` in the same file still collects from the metadata service (PR #25291 note 3): measure whether this card's fix needs it to read the same listing.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included: "REST actions endpoint runs action of disabled package OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED" → 0 matching (nearest #24097, `GET /meta/object/:name` for a disabled package, closed; #21321, install-local script bodies, closed). **New.**
